explication: Univer is an embeddable, plugin-based Office SDK for building spreadsheet, document, and presentation experiences in browser or headless Node.js environments. An integrating application composes the runtime and invokes its Facade; users or agents edit content, the domain packages model and validate it, the formula engine computes spreadsheet results, and the rendering layer presents interactive surfaces. UI and feature plugins add editing tools, while core services provide lifecycle, commands, permissions, and storage abstractions. README-level capabilities guide the architecture; sampled source confirms selected rendering, drag, and storage behavior, not every package connection.
